outcome: Give Banking teams a working Real-Time Transaction Fraud & AML Anomaly Detection capability on their own data — it cuts fraud losses and false-positive review load simultaneously.
overview: Card, transfer and payment fraud lands straight on the P&L, and CBUAE/SAMA anti-fraud and AML mandates make weak controls a supervisory problem as well as a financial one. Real-Time Transaction Fraud & AML Anomaly Detection scores every transaction in sub-second time against anomaly and supervised models, queues what matters for investigators, and auto-drafts suspicious-activity narratives so reporting is audit-ready. It is scoped as a four-to-six week MVP on the bank's own or representative data, not a production rollout: hardening and scale-out are planned separately once fraud loss and false-positive rates are measured against the pre-build baseline.
